title: Kairos Archetype Catalog (v1)
description: Schema for opinionated Kairos archetype catalog files under ontology-reference-models/blueprints/archetypes/. v0 schema (schema_version: 1).

schema_version.description: Catalog schema version. v0 is fixed at 1; a hard fail is expected on mismatch.

id.description: Stable kebab-case archetype identifier. MUST equal the YAML filename stem (enforced by scripts/validate_structure.py).

label.description: Human-readable archetype label (single line, English in v0).

description.description: Short paragraph describing what kinds of companies match this archetype. Prose only, no UX/interview content.

compatible_with.description: Declaration of which ref-model versions this archetype was authored against. The toolkit loader warns on drift.

repo_tag_range.description: SemVer range against this repo's tags (e.g. '>=1.4.0,<2.0.0').

ontology_versions.description: Optional per-ontology SemVer pins. Keys are ontology folder names under derived-ontologies/ (e.g. DCSA, MMT, BSP). Values are SemVer ranges.

ref_model_modules.description: Ref-model ontology modules the archetype expects, identified by their owl:Ontology IRI.

iri.description: Canonical owl:Ontology IRI of the module (e.g. https://www.kairosflow.ai/ont/dcsa/booking). Not a filesystem path.

core_concepts.description: Specific classes the archetype expects to find in the ref-model graph. Each URI must resolve to an owl:Class declared in one of the referenced ontologies.

label.description: Short human-readable label for the concept (used by the toolkit skill for display).

tier.description: Conformance tier for a module or concept.
